_comment: Instance-0 A/B task declarations (SoT §7). Instance DATA, not core code (so core ab_tasks.py stays corpus-agnostic / G1-clean). 30 tasks: 12 fixture (from the p2 acceptance fixture — engine was tuned on these; they measure token cost, not generalization) / 10 organic (realistic tool queries incl. 2 refusal-expected zero-coverage goals, FCL-008 shape) / 8 corpus-private (facts that exist ONLY in this graph — minted confidences, mint ids, extracted_from mappings, handbook capability ids — post-date any pretraining corpus, so only the graph arm can answer them). Prompts are natural language and carry ZERO node_ids or graph markers (arm-B prompt-leakage check). The `graph` field drives arm A's context only.
